Maslenitsa é uma antiga festa russa da d: Maslenitsa is an ancient Russian festival that says farewell to winter. It is celebrated in the last week before Great Lent, usually in February or March. By tradition, people make blini on these days, because they are round and golden like the sun. Blini are said to bring warmth to the home. Guests gather at the same table, treat one another to food, sing and play. At the end of the festival it is customary to burn an effigy of winter. In this way people say goodbye to the cold and rejoice in the spring.
